integrity.claim_status: unrestricted theorem proved from explicit modular maps; finite test is supplementary
integrity.reproducibility: check_orbits.py; 54 independent finite-ring breadth-first-search residue-set equalities, all six triples and exponents 1 to 9; inductive ternary projection lemma from order of 2 modulo 3-powers; parity and last odd/even-producing generator decomposition; boundary k=1 and k=2 verified separately.

scientific_limitations: Only finite quotients modulo 2 times a power of three are classified; no result about ordinary density follows.
The existing single-orbit modular profile for (0,2,3) is credited as prior work, not new.
Earlier full-text historical sources were not exhaustively accessible; implicit-priority risk remains.
title: Complete parity–ternary residue profiles of the six critical Klarner affine orbit sets
